risk.heading: What this position actually is
risk.roiNote: Against the money you put up
risk.disclaimer: Simplified: maintenance margin, fees and funding all bring liquidation closer than shown. Treat these as a ceiling, not a promise.

info.intro: None of this is advice. It is arithmetic that stays true whatever the market does.
info.liquidationBody: At 25× a 4% move against you wipes the whole margin. At 100× it takes 1%. The higher the leverage, the tighter the stop the exchange sets on your behalf — and it does not ask first.
info.feesBody: Commission and funding are charged on the notional, not on your money. At 25× you pay twenty-five times what the amount suggests, whether the trade wins or loses.
info.asymmetryBody: Down 50% needs up 100% to get back to even. Down 80% needs 400%. Leverage moves you along that curve much faster than it moves you back.
